name: Bijin de Yasashi Hitozuma Joushi ni Yuuwaku Sarete Itsudemo Himitsu no Office Love~
original_name: 美人で優しい人妻上司に誘惑されて ～いつでも秘密のオフィスラブ～
source:
I, Kaoru Daita, had been making mistakes ever since I started this job.
So, after finishing overtime, I told my supervisor, Naomi, that I wanted to quit.
She tried to stop me, but…

"I’m just dead weight here."
"At least I don’t think that."
"Then… what do you think of me?"

Her face flushed slightly, and she said—
"I like you. I really like you."

Like me? That couldn’t be true!
Besides, she’s married!

"Hehe… Maybe this will convince you?"
Naomi pulled me, still stunned, closer to her…

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ01001095.html/]dlsite[/url]]
